== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The earlier full issuer face has power 5, deploy 3, forfeit 7, and neither Pilot nor Warrior. The later slip shows 4, 4, 6 and both icons. The later text also removes the Edge retrieval reduction, limits the Death Star spy restriction to the opponent’s spies and adjusts the Rebel battle-destiny condition. Vader and the once-per-game search remain.
